typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		TRADE_DATE_TIME as timestamp,
		TRADER_NAME as string,
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		SALES_PERSON as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		MODIF_DATE as timestamp,
		MODIF_DATENOTIME as string,
		TRADE_CURRENCY as string,
		CPTY_SHORTNAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		ENTITY_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(toInteger(OLEDBSource@ENTITY_ID) == LookupLKPTABLE@ENTITY_ID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		ENTITY_ID = OLEDBSource@ENTITY_ID,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		TRADER_NAME = TRADER_NAME,
		BOOK_NAME = BOOK_NAME,
		TRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS,
		SALES_PERSON = SALES_PERSON,
		PRODUCT_TYPE = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		MODIF_DATE = MODIF_DATE,
		MODIF_DATENOTIME = MODIF_DATENOTIME,
		TRADE_CURRENCY = TRADE_CURRENCY,
		CPTY_SHORTNAME = CPTY_SHORTNAME
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup01
Lookup01 filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 derive(Loaddate = currentTimestamp()) ~> AddloadDate
Lookup0 aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
AddloadDate sink(input(
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		ENTITY_ID as integer,
		modif_dateNoTime as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TRADER_NAME as string,
		MODIF_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Currency as string,
		Load_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		SALES_PERSON as string,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		Cpty_ShortName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PRODUCT_TYPE,
		ENTITY_ID,
		modif_dateNoTime = MODIF_DATENOTIME,
		TRADER_NAME,
		MODIF_DATE,
		Currency = TRADE_CURRENCY,
		Load_Date = Loaddate,
		BOOK_NAME,
		SALES_PERSON,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		TRADE_STATUS,
		Cpty_ShortName = CPTY_SHORTNAME),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
